text:
marina: Canary push for release v2.14.0 is on hold. Image was pushed to eu-ecr but the tag got overtaken by a concurrent nightly pipeline and cosign attestation for arm64 is missing, so canary not promoted.

deploy-bot: [automated] publish attempt failed: 409 Conflict - tag collision (manifest sha256:85a3d2...).

anya: which pipeline grabbed the tag? link to CI?

marina: nightly-builds/roll-bump ran and applied :latest at the same time; looks like a race between bake and promotion jobs.

samir: can you show `aws ecr` output?

marina: ```
$ aws ecr batch-get-image --repository-name redwood/runtime --image-ids imageTag=v2.14.0
Error: Image with tag v2.14.0 not found
```

ryan: deploybot logs show initial push -> sha256:85a3d2..., then another push repointed tag to sha256:bf11c9... likely due to nightly regenerating the manifestlist.

anya: cosign verify shows amd64 signed but arm64 missing. we should not promote without full provenance.

ops-lead: decision: rollback canary or pin to the signed digest? change window ends ~40m.

samir: pin to digest for canary if we can validate signatures for that digest. also block nightly promotion for +1h.

marina: manual plan: pin canary route to sha256:85a3d2... and update release notes; if arm64 attestation not present by 16:30 UTC we rollback.

anya: i'll patch CI to stop nightly promotion and add a repo lock. @ryan for infra approval.

ryan: approved. set pub-scheduler lock: `lock redwood/runtime +3600s`.

marina: manual pin executed: `deploy-bot promote --digest sha256:85a3d2... --route canary --meta "pin:manual-missing-arm64"`

deploy-bot: [automated] promote accepted. canary now resolves to sha256:85a3d2....

marina: release notes: "Canary pinned to digest due to missing arm64 attestation. Monitoring; rollback scheduled if errors."

ryan: I'll rebuild the arm64 artifact and sign with eu-kms key. ETA ~12m.

ryan: rebuild done, signing... `cosign sign --key eu-kms://projects/keys/rdw-sign eu.gcr.io/redwood/runtime@sha256:85a3d2...` -> Successfully signed.

anya: verify: `cosign verify eu.gcr.io/redwood/runtime@sha256:85a3d2...` -> OK, signed by eu-kms://projects/keys/rdw-sign.

marina: verified. removing manual pin. `deploy-bot unpin --route canary`.

deploy-bot: [automated] unpin accepted. canary now resolves to tag v2.14.0 via digest sha256:85a3d2... with provenance verified for all platforms.

ops-lead: nice. update release notes to record the manual pin and attestation backfill. review nightly job lock.

marina: done. changelog entry added.

anya: proposal: add guard in deploybot to prefer digest pinning when label `provenance:required` present; will open RFC/ticket.

ops-lead: track in follow-up ticket. good coordination. closing when prod promote scheduled.

marina: thanks team :thumbsup: 

deploy-bot: [automated] next steps queued -> prod-promote checklist created: #PR-1348
